name: MCP server
summary: Publishing an MCP server so agents can use your product through tools rather than by scraping pages or driving a browser. The server wraps your API as tools, resources and prompts, usually as a remote server over Streamable HTTP with OAuth.
how: Pick the actions and data agents need most
Implement them as tools and resources with an official MCP SDK
Host it remotely over Streamable HTTP with OAuth authorization
Document the server URL in your docs or llms.txt
Test it in clients such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code
facts: Agents can act directly, but you own another API surface and its security
goodFor: SaaS products agents should act on
watchOut: Needs auth, rate limits and abuse handling like any API
Tool descriptions must be written for models
Spec is still changing between versions
